name: com.wallofdecks/wall-of-decks
title: Wall of Decks
description: Look up real pre-seed and seed pitch deck slides by section, stage and reviewer verdict.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Returns every slide section (problem, team, traction, ask and the rest) with its id, name, a one-line meaning, how many slide images it has and the share of decks that include it. Call it first to get the section ids that search_slides takes. For numbers to compare a deck against, such as median slide count or where each section first appears, call section_benchmarks instead. Each item has id, name, about, slides_with_image and share_of_decks (0 to 1, among decks with a full slide list).

tools.name: search_slides
tools.description: Returns example slides from real pre-seed, angel and seed pitch decks, filtered by section, stage, outcome, reviewer verdict or words. Use it to show what a section looks like in practice; get section ids from list_sections. Only slides with an image are searched. Results are spread across decks: each deck contributes its first matching slide before any deck contributes a second. The result has total (all matches) and slides; each slide has its deck summary, n, position ("n of slide count"), section, section_name, label, image_url, and any verdict, review_point and review_note. Slides belong to the companies that made them; cite the deck source_url when you use one.

section.description: Only slides of this section. The ids are the ones list_sections returns; "other" is slides that fit no section.

stage.description: Round stage. "early" is pre-seed and angel rounds; "seed" is seed rounds. Leave out for every stage.

outcome.description: How the raise went. "funded" is decks that raised the round; "failed" covers rounds that did not close and first versions that investors rejected. Leave out for both.

verdict.description: Only slides a reviewer or the founder commented on: "praised" for slides called good, "criticised" for slides called weak. Leave out for all slides.

query.description: Words to look for, case-insensitive. A slide matches when every word appears somewhere in its company name, slide label, review point or note, section name or stage name. Words match parts of words too ("pay" matches "payments").

limit.description: How many slides to return, 1 to 30. Defaults to 10; total still counts every match.

tools.name: list_decks
tools.description: Returns a summary of every deck in the library, optionally filtered by stage and outcome. Use it to find deck ids; call get_deck for one deck with all its slides, or search_slides to find slides across decks. Each item has id, company, stage, amount, year, outcome, outcome_note, slide_count, url, source and source_url. Slides belong to the companies that made them; cite the deck source_url when you use one.

stage.description: Round stage. "early" is pre-seed and angel rounds; "seed" is seed rounds. Leave out for every stage.

outcome.description: How the raise went. "funded" is decks that raised the round; "failed" covers rounds that did not close and first versions that investors rejected. Leave out for both.

tools.name: get_deck
tools.description: Returns one deck: its summary, company facts and every listed slide in order with its section. Use it when you need a whole deck; for a single slide call get_slide, and for decks you have no id for call list_decks first. Each slide has n (1-based), section, section_name, label, appendix, image_url, and any verdict, review_point and review_note. Slides belong to the companies that made them; cite the deck source_url when you use one.

id.description: A deck id from list_decks or search_slides, such as "airbnb".

tools.name: get_slide
tools.description: Returns one slide of one deck, with the deck summary, by deck id and slide number. Use it to look up a slide you already know, such as one named in a get_deck or search_slides result; use get_deck for the whole deck. The result has deck (the summary) and the slide fields from get_deck, plus position ("n of slide count") and page_url, the slide on the deck page. Slides belong to the companies that made them; cite the deck source_url when you use one.

deck_id.description: A deck id from list_decks or search_slides, such as "airbnb".

n.description: The slide number, counted from 1, as n in get_deck.

tools.name: section_benchmarks
tools.description: Returns numbers for comparing a deck's structure: the median slide count and, for each section, the share of decks that have it and the median slide where it first appears. Use it to check a deck's length or order against the library, optionally for one stage or outcome. For what each section means, call list_sections; for example slides, call search_slides. Only decks with a full slide list are counted, and appendix slides are left out. The result has decks_compared, median_slides, middle_half (the 25th and 75th percentile slide counts) and sections, each with id, name, share_of_decks and median_first_slide.

stage.description: Round stage. "early" is pre-seed and angel rounds; "seed" is seed rounds. Leave out for every stage.

outcome.description: How the raise went. "funded" is decks that raised the round; "failed" covers rounds that did not close and first versions that investors rejected. Leave out for both.
